name: archify
description: Create validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML with tt-a1i's Archify. Installs the original; its Node CLI runs from the skill folder.

name: architecture-decision-records
description: Write or review architecture decision records. Use for ADRs, significant technology choices, design trade-offs, decision history, or superseding an accepted architectural decision. Overlaps with grilling on trade-offs, planning-with-files on decision notes, harness-decide on decision history, and harness-write on reader-facing rationale; focuses on lasting rationale and supersession.

name: awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
description: Reference guide to gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills for game development with Godot, Unity, Unreal, web, and other engines: gameplay, assets, UI, audio, genres, and publishing. Use /awesome-gamedev-agent-skills to find and read the matching upstream skill. Upstream skills and scripts are not bundled or installed.

name: brainstorming
description: Brainstorm ideas, clarify requirements, compare approaches, and refine designs before implementation. Use for /brainstorming, "brainstorm", "explore alternatives", or "help design this". Overlaps with grilling on questions and trade-offs; focuses on developing alternatives collaboratively.

name: differential-review
description: Review security implications of code changes against a baseline. Use for security reviews of PRs, commits, uncommitted diffs, or removed validation; not for routine formatting or a claim of full-codebase audit coverage. Overlaps with harness-review and pr-review on code review; focuses on reachable security regressions.

name: dri
description: [investigate] Alone: DRI status. Text: investigate that incident. Investigate a production incident as a read-only copilot for the on-call DRI: gather evidence, separate facts from hypotheses, and draft next steps and updates. Also holds the proposed DRI-agent design (staged roles, preflight checks, evaluation) while it grows. Service specifics come from the project's private DRI profile. Never changes production or posts updates without explicit approval. Overlaps with harness-monitor on incidents: harness-monitor detects health breaches and proposes work; dri investigates one incident.

name: github-issues
description: Find, draft, create, or update GitHub issues. Use for bug reports, feature requests, issue triage, labels, assignees, milestones, and issue relationships in an explicitly identified repository.

name: graphify
description: Reference guide to the upstream Graphify knowledge-graph skill; its CLI is not installed here. Use to locate authoritative Graphify guidance and its official install workflow.

name: grilling
description: Stress-test a plan, decision, or idea through a staged decision-tree interview. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on trade-offs and planning-with-files on planning; focuses on reaching a shared decision.

name: handoff
description: Prepare a concise continuation note for another session or person. Use for /handoff or an explicit request to save work for a later session. Overlaps with harness-setup on context summaries; creates a note rather than a live status view or process-control action.

name: harness-decide
description: [closed|all] Alone: open decisions. Text: explain it, then decide. Keep the harness decision register: list open decisions apart from optional setup, explain a decision or question with its options, and save the choice, or leave a new question open. Shorthand: /hn-decide. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on history; owns the compact bulletin and register.

name: harness-dev
description: [upsert|queue|sprint|test|broad] Alone: the board. Text: develop it. Record, queue, and develop tasks with the two-reviewer review loop, run goal-based sprints, and declare or run reusable tests; broad raises one task's reviews and unit tests. Shorthand: /hn-dev. Overlaps with harness-monitor on intake and checks, harness-review on code review, and harness-write on report implementation; sprints can draft status through harness-write.

name: harness-monitor
description: [accept|auto] Alone: last results. Text: check one, or a new link. Monitor work across approved source adapters, including ADO and documents, and numeric health observations: assess relevance, verify status with AI model auto, reconcile evidence, and propose ranked tasks; auto follows a source up through an approved local-only worker flow. Shorthand: /hn-monitor. Overlaps with harness-dev on intake and checks, kpi-dashboard on metric contracts, harness-write on status and owner evidence, and dri on incidents; preserves deferred work and never launches development.

name: harness-review
description: [broad|list] Alone: review your changes. Text: review that scope. Review current-project changes for blocking issues with two independent reviewers per pass, GPT and Claude Opus, plus a whole-repository Fresh pass when no new findings appear, restarting when local files change; broad also reports minor and existing issues. Shorthand: /hn-review. Overlaps with pr-review on general review, differential-review on security, and harness-dev, whose development loop runs the same passes; PR URLs delegate to pr-review.

name: harness-runtime
description: Shared PowerShell 7 runtime for the harness topics: the harness.ps1 entry point, the runtime guide, and the default review model list. Not invoked directly; use harness-setup (setup, context, policy), harness-dev, harness-write, harness-review, harness-decide, harness-monitor, or harness-schedule.

name: harness-schedule
description: [clean] Alone: all schedules. Text: set one, like pr 1d or pr off. Manage logical schedules under one user-wide heartbeat for projects, PR review, refresh, and maintenance: set, turn off or on, convert old SkillVault Windows tasks, and clean up stale schedules. Shorthand: /hn-schedule. Overlaps with schedule-manage on Windows task administration; owns SkillVault schedules. Maintenance delegates history cleanup to harness-setup clean.

name: harness-setup
description: [root|clean|policy] Alone: set up or status. Text: add a source, or ask. Set up and steer a harness project: create it or convert an old layout, show status, select or move its root, register sources and coding repositories, brief a task, delete old run history, and set limits, failure handling, retention, and pause, stop, and resume. Shorthand: /hn-setup. Briefings overlap with handoff; harness-schedule schedules maintenance.

name: harness-write
description: [slots] Alone: your drafts. Text: write it. Draft and update writing for people: evidence-grounded feature docs, onboarding, and troubleshooting guides; stakeholder trackers, meeting invites, and email updates or thread replies; and dashboards, reports, and queries; slots ranks meeting times offline. Shorthand: /hn-write. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on rationale, harness-monitor on status and owner evidence, harness-dev on report implementation, kpi-dashboard and jarvis-metrics on report design, and the office-documents and ppt-master references on document output. Drafts only: never sends, invites, shares, or publishes without explicit approval.

name: humanizer
description: Rewrite AI-sounding prose without changing what it says, with blader's Humanizer; overlaps with humanizer-ch on rewriting, while keeping a general-prose scope. Installs the original.

name: humanizer-ch
description: Reference guide to zjqc/humanizer-ch for Chinese critical essays and theoretical commentary. Use /humanizer-ch to locate upstream guidance; overlaps with humanizer on prose editing. Upstream rules and scripts are not bundled.

name: jarvis-metrics
description: Design Jarvis metrics and dashboards from existing Geneva/MDM metrics, Kusto queries, or logs. Use for /jarvis-metrics, Jarvis dashboard creation, metric-source selection, pre-aggregation, dimensions, monitors, and CDS-style success/failure reporting. Overlaps with kpi-dashboard on dashboard/metric design and harness-write on Jarvis authoring; owns Jarvis metric-source plumbing and widget configuration rather than general dispatch or layout guidance.

name: kpi-dashboard
description: Define actionable KPIs and design dashboard layouts, comparisons, filters, and freshness states. Use for /kpi-dashboard, executive SaaS dashboards, MRR/churn/LTV-CAC metrics, operations-center views, cohort retention, or conflicting metric calculations. Overlaps with harness-write on authoring, harness-monitor on metric contracts, jarvis-metrics on dashboard design, powerbi-modeling on grain and measure semantics, and the ppt-master reference on presentation design; supplies reusable, platform-agnostic design guidance, not a platform writer, incident engine, or Jarvis-specific metric-source workflow.

name: office-documents
description: Reference to Anthropic's PDF, Word, and Excel document skills for merging PDFs, cleaning spreadsheets, and document formatting. Use /office-documents to locate the relevant guidance. Overlaps with harness-write on document output and workbook/report validation; upstream tools are not bundled and their proprietary terms apply.

name: openapi-spec
description: Design and validate REST API contracts. Use for /openapi-spec, OpenAPI or Swagger specifications, code-first API documentation, request and response schemas, contract drift, or SDK input specifications.

name: planning-with-files
description: Keep task plans, findings, and progress on disk for long multi-step work with OthmanAdi's planning-with-files; overlaps with grilling on planning and architecture-decision-records on notes. Installs the original; its hooks run local scripts in hosts that support skill hooks.

name: powerbi-modeling
description: Design and review Power BI semantic models, star schemas, fact and dimension grain, relationships, DAX measures, RLS, and performance. Use for /powerbi-modeling, model design, cardinality, cross-filter direction, or model optimization. Overlaps with kpi-dashboard on grain and metric definitions; owns model structure and validation, not dashboard layout or automatic deployment. Design-only use needs no live connection.

name: ppt-master
description: Create native editable PowerPoint (PPTX) decks, reusable templates, brand colors, fonts, and slide layouts with Hugo He's PPT Master; overlaps with harness-write on artifact validation and kpi-dashboard on presentation design. Installs the original, about 13,000 files; its Python tools need their own dependencies.

name: pr-publish
description: [list] Alone: publish this branch's PR. Text: adjust it, like show me first. Create or update your own pull request with a current vs. to-be scenario table. A new PR gets a short description in the style of the GitHub Pull Requests extension's create-pull-request skill and opens ready for review; an existing PR keeps its description and gets only the table. Overlaps with that skill on opening PRs and uses its VS Code tool when available, otherwise gh; pr-review reviews PRs instead. Never pushes or writes to a PR without an explicit ask.

name: pr-review
description: [broad|list|configure] Alone: review watched PRs. Text: review that PR. Review PRs from a URL, a repository, or the user-wide watchlist for blocking issues in isolated snapshots; broad also reports minor and existing issues. Overlaps with harness-review on general review and differential-review on security; owns remote selection and isolated evidence, while pr-watch manages targets.

name: pr-watch
description: [remove] Alone: the watchlist. Text: watch a URL. Manage the single user-wide PR review watchlist. Watchlist changes do not run reviews or change schedules; pr-review owns execution and review results, and harness-schedule owns its logical schedule.

name: rag-implementation
description: RAG implementation guidance adapted from wshobson/agents. Use for document Q&A, chunking, retrieval, reranking, and grounded answers. Its examples need dependency and behavior checks; no runtime or data access is bundled.

name: rules
description: [apply|remove] Alone: rules in effect. Text: add or change a rule. Put the core and extra rules, or only the four core rules with apply core, into effect globally (default), in a project, or for this chat; add, change, or remove your own global or project rules. The SkillVault rule library changes only when you name extra or core, and persistent rule changes require confirmation.

name: schedule-manage
description: [enable|disable|delete] Alone: Windows tasks. Text: filter them. Manage Windows scheduled tasks, selected by number, list, range, or keyword. Triggers on "list schedules", "list scheduled tasks", "enable scheduled task", "disable scheduled task", or "delete scheduled task". Overlaps with harness-schedule on enabling and disabling tasks; covers general schedule administration.

name: skillvault-author
description: [remove] Alone: the catalog. Text: create or change it. Author and maintain skill bundles and catalog entries in the SkillVault repository, not application source or installed copies. Shorthand: /sv-author. Overlaps with VS Code's agent-customization skill on writing SKILL.md files; use this one only for skills in the SkillVault repository and its catalog. Never installs; use skillvault-install to install the result.

name: skillvault-discover
description: [explain] Alone: past evaluations. Text: search or evaluate it. Discover skills for a purpose, evaluate a candidate against the catalog and earlier evaluations, and explain skills, tools, or products. Shorthand: /sv-discover. Evaluation saves a public-safe assessment unless chat only; search and explanation are read-only. None installs, runs, or edits the target.

name: skillvault-install
description: [list|update|uninstall|clean|refresh] Alone: the catalog. Text: install it. Manage installed SkillVault copies and keep them current: install by exact name or a * pattern, list installed copies, update them from the local checkout, uninstall, clean up copies that load twice or conflict, and refresh from upstream. Shorthand: /sv-install. Clean shows overlaps, which skillvault-discover can evaluate; refresh scheduling delegates to harness-schedule. Edits no SkillVault source or application code except refresh's adaptation merges; skillvault-author owns skill authoring.

name: supabase-postgres-best-practices
description: Review Postgres SQL, schemas, migrations, query plans, indexes, connection pooling, locks, and row-level security. Use for Postgres-backed work; do not apply database-specific advice to SQL Server or other engines.

name: trading-signal-analysis
description: Evaluate historical trading approaches, price patterns, or screenshots through signal-outcome studies. Use for historical backtesting, target-hit and endpoint-close rates, matched-peer benchmarks, percentage-point differences, and lookback, target, or follow-up sensitivity. Keep research distinct from profit claims and trade advice.

name: webapp-testing
description: Verify local web applications with Playwright. Use for browser regression checks, frontend interactions, UI failures, screenshots, and browser console diagnostics.
